observations: Photo 0 shows a full-size portable electronic keyboard, black body, cream and black keys, lying on a wooden table.
Brand name 'YAMAHA' is printed clearly on the control panel in both photos.
A faint model code is visible near the top-right in photo 0 and bottom panel in photo 1, but the characters are too blurred/small to read with confidence.
Photo 1 is a close-up of the control panel: power on/off switch, tempo buttons, numeric keypad, style/voice buttons, and a printed song/rhythm list (01-40 and 31-40 shown).
Watermarks 'POSTED ON NIJI' and 'NITTY MUSICALS' overlay both images, indicating a resale listing photo, not an original seller photo.
No power adapter, headphone jack close-up, or power-on/sound-producing state is visible in either photo.
Keys show slight yellowing/wear consistent with age or UV exposure.
No visible cracks, missing keys, or obvious physical damage in the photos provided.

claims.evidence: Yamaha brand name visible on control panel in photo 0 and photo 1
Rhythm/song list printed in photo 1 shows only numbers up to 40; no way to confirm total voice/style count from a static photo
No headphone jack or rear panel is visible in either photo
No import sticker, grading tag, or box/paperwork shown; grading claims cannot be confirmed from photos

risks.risk: Keyboard may not power on or may have non-functional keys/speakers
risks.proof: Video clip of the unit powering on, playing a demo song, and pressing several keys across the range with audible sound

risks.risk: Headphone jack or audio output may be faulty or missing
risks.proof: Photo/video of headphones plugged in with audible output, or clear shot of the rear/side port panel
risks.if_unproven: priced as if output not working

risks.proof: Photo of the actual power adapter included with the unit, showing voltage/plug type
risks.if_unproven: priced as unit only, no adapter

risks.risk: Sticky, dead, or cracked keys not visible at this angle/resolution
risks.proof: Close-up photos of full key range from directly above, plus video of each key being pressed
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming some keys may be faulty

risks.risk: 'UK-Used Grade A' condition claim cannot be verified, item could be lower grade
risks.proof: Photo of any import/grading sticker or original packaging/documentation

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powering on and playing sound (keys, demo song, and a few preset voices/rhythms)
Clear close-up photo of the full model number/serial plate (usually on the back or near the brand logo)
Photo of the rear panel showing power input and headphone/audio output ports
Photo of the power adapter included, if any
Full top-down photo of all keys in good lighting without watermark obstruction
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Yamaha-branded portable keyboard by type, but functional claims (voices, headphone output, grading) are unverifiable from static photos, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, possibly non-functional used keyboard until proof is supplied.
